title: The Book of Enoch: A Study Circle Guide
description: A free seven-session discussion guide for groups reading The Book of Enoch: A Black Reader's Study Edition: Bible studies, Sunday school classes, book clubs, campus fellowships and families. One session for each of the book's seven Parts, each about 75 minutes (Open, Read aloud, Talk, Carry, This week), with leader notes, the circle's promises, a fourteen-week option, and "Questions We Are Keeping." Includes a careful note for the session on the hardest chapter. 40 pages, PDF. Free to copy and share for non-commercial study.
